description: Fix chunks(values, size) to split a list into consecutive chunks of positive size, including the final incomplete chunk. The input list must not be mutated.
initial_source:
def chunks(values, size):
    return [values[i:i+size] for i in range(0, len(values)-size+1, size)]
reference_source:
def chunks(values, size):
    return [values[i:i+size] for i in range(0, len(values), size)]
